description:
How long the caller's cash lasts if costs move as the lane's price
scenario says.

Needs cash on hand, revenue, margin and fixed costs in `profile.business`;
each one absent is named in `missing` (`projected: false`). Returns
`runway_months_low`/`mid`/`high` and `worst_drawdown_gbp` over
`horizon_months` (default 12); a runway longer than the horizon is `null`.
When the profile also plans an order, the plan's cash answer is added
(`source: "plan"`): `plan_first_break_month` and
`plan_first_break_amount_gbp` (first month below the cash floor),
`plan_first_below_zero_month`, `plan_lowest_cash_gbp`,
`plan_horizon_months`.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: cash_runway
title: Cash runway
